svg.title: Components map v2 for Aarav's startup funding pulse
svg.desc: Swimlane grid with eight actors and six stages. Aarav forwards LinkedIn and X posts to a Telegram bot and edits his config; both are stored in Neon Postgres. A Monday cron pulls news feeds, Gemini Flash extracts deals using Neon data and saves them back, a second Gemini Flash step writes the brief, and Aarav reviews the emailed brief.
